newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 per tonne lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 per tonne lower.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $5 a tonne lower on Monday, on the heels of a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.
London cocoa futures were mainly lower in light trading early Monday. LIFFE July cocoa was down eight stg at the midday break, to 1,030 stg, while September fell seven stg to 1,046 stg.

Friday, New York cocoa futures tumbled in light trading, pressured by speculative liquidation. July dropped $29 a tonne on the day, to close at $1,469, after ranging from $1,502 to $1,467. Second-month September ended $27 lower, at $1,501, while the back months slumped $24 to $34.
On the charts, traders said July would probably find initial support at $1,457-$1,454, with a stronger downside target at $1,444. On the upside, resistance was pegged at $1,490.
